goal: Evolve users.full_name into split given_name and family_name columns and update Customer REST/Protobuf contracts with zero downtime across rolling deployments

expand.description: Add nullable given_name and family_name columns, drop NOT NULL on legacy full_name, build concurrent index, and deploy dual-write adapter while retaining legacy reads

migrate.description: Execute keyset-paginated backfill in 1,000-row batches with 100ms jittered delay, validate NOT VALID check constraint, and cut over reads to given_name/family_name
migrate.verification_gate: Zero NULL rows in given_name/family_name and 100% shadow-read parity over 24 hours

contract.description: Remove dual-write code references after N-1 pods and mobile horizon drain, drop legacy full_name column under lock_timeout, and reserve Protobuf tag 4
contract.drain_prerequisite: 0% Version N-1 server pods active and 0 legacy API version requests over 30-day telemetry window

rollback_safety.rehearsal_evidence: Verified N-1 integration test suite passes INSERT and SELECT queries against Phase 1 expanded PostgreSQL schema

verdict.rationale: All schema changes follow 3-phase Expand-Migrate-Contract with 2000ms lock_timeout, non-blocking constraint validation, batched backfills, and dual-payload wire compatibility.
revisit_triggers: PostgreSQL replication lag exceeds 2000ms during Phase 2 backfill
Legacy mobile client traffic on API version < 2026-11-10 exceeds 0.1% before Phase 3 contraction
